I had the pleasure of meeting the wonderful women of @dstinc1913. These women show that sisterhood rooted in scholarship, service, and advocacy can make a major impact in South Carolina, DC, and across the country!
 
Certainly glad I wore my red tie today!

The Biden administration’s open border policies have resulted in tragic consequences. The killing of Sheridan Gorman at the hands of an illegal immigrant who was negligently released into our country was preventable.

Fund DHS. Protect American lives.


Fox News (@FoxNews)

Happy National Ag Day!

In South Carolina, we know our farmers are the backbone of our communities. Thanks to the Working Families Tax Cut, farmers and their families in the Palmetto State will see $49 million in savings on crop insurance - delivering real relief for those who feed and fuel America.

Congratulations to @USCAiken women’s polo team on their national championship victory! What an incredible performance - way to represent the Palmetto State.


USC Aiken (@USCAiken)

Our women’s polo team claimed the national title after a dominant 15–6 victory over Texas A&M at the 2026 USPA Division I National Intercollegiate Championship in Dallas.

Join us in congratulating these ladies on an unforgettable season and championship win! 🏇🏆





— https://nitter.net/USCAiken/status/203609325

Congratulations to my friend and colleague, @SenMullin, on his confirmation to be Secretary of the Department of Homeland Security!

We’ll miss him in the Senate, but I have no doubt he’ll lead DHS with the utmost commitment to ensuring the safety and security of our nation.
Proud to cheer on Coach @dawnstaley and @GamecockWBB tonight as they represent South Carolina with grit, excellence, and heart. Let’s keep dancing! 🤙 #MarchMadness

Appreciate the support for the PREDICT Act! We know that detecting and understanding threats early is how we stay prepared, respond effectively, and keep Americans safe.


Tim Young (@TimRunsHisMouth)

This is a brilliant bill by @SenatorTimScott - 

Wastewater monitoring in order to predict outbreaks and health threats - even things like potential poisoning of our food/water supply.

It's called the Predict Act and it's something we should be paying attention to in Congress.

In addition to being a veteran of the first Gulf War, she’s earned two Emmy nominations, is a two-time Radio Television Digital News Association of the Carolinas winner, and has been recognized by local and state leaders for her service to the community.

79% of Americans agree that men should not compete in women’s sports. Today I voted for an amendment to the SAVE America Act to protect female athletes and their opportunity to compete fairly. #SaveAmericanSports

Catherine Porth is a third-generation produce farmer dedicated to sharing the story of agriculture. On her family farm in Lexington County, she grows crops such as collards, mustard greens, kale, spinach, okra, cucumbers, and crowder peas.

Catherine enjoys connecting with students and teaching them the importance of where their food comes from! #WomensHistoryMonth #NationalAgWeek

Megan Floyd grows corn, cotton, soybeans, wheat, and more alongside her family in the Pee Dee.

Through her work with the South Carolina Farm Bureau Women’s Leadership Committee, she’s passionate about supporting the future of agriculture - especially women in ag. #WomensHistoryMonth #NationalAgWeek
Hats off to the @ClemsonMBB and @FurmanMBB teams representing the Palmetto State in the dance. No matter the outcome, you’ve made South Carolina proud!

Marilyn Easter is a third-generation dairy farmer in Laurens County, where she and her husband have owned and operated Eastglen Jersey Farm for over 50 years, producing 6 million pounds of milk per year.

She is passionate about being a voice for agriculture through her longtime involvement with 4-H, FFA, and ag literacy programs. #WomensHistoryMonth #NationalAgWeek

Historic moment for College of Charleston women’s basketball - their first March Madness appearance! A milestone that will be remembered and a big step forward for the program. No matter the score, South Carolina is proud of @CofCWBB!
